verdict: A delivery outage spiked costs this week; the 28-day base holds steady.
narrative: You received 84 leads over the last 28 days at $23.92 per lead, all through Meta. This past week, a confirmed zero-spend day on August 6th halted delivery entirely, which mechanically drove the 44% week-over-week lead drop and the 48% cost-per-lead spike — the underlying campaign structure did not change. Separately, your Google Business Profile stopped recording actions for six consecutive days, pointing to a listing or tracking disruption rather than a drop in interest. Ad delivery has been restored and the Business Profile issue is being investigated now. Next week's numbers should reflect a return to normal pacing, and we're watching lead-to-intake conversion closely given a gap between leads arriving and pipeline activity.
